items.prompt:
"Create an ultra-realistic cinematic fashion photograph of an adult woman(match face) standing indoors in a warm rustic wooden café or farmhouse kitchen, captured in a vertical portrait composition.

Appearance: Long chestnut-brown hair with natural soft waves, wispy face-framing bangs and realistic individual strands, delicate natural makeup with softly defined eyes, subtle rosy cheeks and natural pink lips, luminous realistic skin, and a calm, subtly confident expression looking directly toward the camera.

Outfit: a fitted blue denim short overall with adjustable shoulder straps, brass metal buckles, detailed stitching, a large front bib pocket, side buttons, and rolled-up shorts. Natural fabric texture and realistic denim folds.

Pose:

1. Standing beside a rustic wooden counter, torso slightly angled toward the camera, both arms raised naturally above and behind her head as she gently gathers her hair with both hands. Relaxed shoulders, natural posture, anatomically correct arms and hands with realistic finger placement.

2. Seated pose: Sitting naturally on a rustic wooden stool beside the counter, torso slightly angled toward the camera, one leg relaxed forward and the other slightly bent, feet resting naturally on the floor. Her back remains comfortably straight as she gently gathers her hair behind her head with both hands, elbows naturally raised and relaxed. Calm, subtly confident expression looking directly toward the camera, with anatomically correct proportions, realistic hands and fingers, and a relaxed editorial posture.

Setting: Cozy rustic wooden interior with warm timber walls and cabinetry, shelves with subtle glassware and bottles in the background, a glass vase containing green leafy branches on the counter, and sunlight streaming through a nearby window.

Lighting: Warm golden-hour sunlight, soft directional window light, realistic highlights and shadows, subtle cinematic depth, natural skin tones, shallow depth of field, beautifully blurred background.

Photography: High-end fashion editorial aesthetic, photorealistic, cinematic color grading, 50mm lens, f/2.0, crisp facial details, realistic skin texture, natural proportions, high dynamic range, fine fabric and hair detail, professional photography, 9:16ar"
items.title: 海滨长廊金色人像
